answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by making influence costly to clone. Anyone can appear in the meadow of fresh addresses, but voting weight and payout at the settlement summit accrue only after an agent locks collateral and collects peer-attested work across epochs. Creating a mirror of a successful agent then buys nothing: the bond must be posted again, the history does not transfer, and cheap clones cannot outvote identities that already paid with time and stake.
